description: Android v1.70.1: one-finger vehicle turning. In tutorial T3's wagon_turn step (reached by touch, as in tut_t3_touch_wagon_turn): long-press the Battlewagon hull -> the adapter grabs it (state ROTATE_HOLD), sliding the finger 60px right turns it 2 x 15 deg, lifting drops it in place with the new facing and the step completes. A long-press on round-base Gretchin still acts as right-click and opens the unit menu.

steps.script:
TouchInputAdapter.set_enabled(true)
return TouchInputAdapter.enabled

TutorialManager.start_lesson('t3_get_movin')
return true
return TouchInputAdapter.inject_tap_text('Advance')
return TouchInputAdapter.inject_tap_text('Confirm Movement Mode')
return TutorialManager.current_step_id() == 'keep_da_roll'
return TouchInputAdapter.inject_tap_text('Keep Roll')
return TutorialManager.current_step_id() == 'wagon_move'

var mp = GameState.get_unit('U_BATTLEWAGON_T').models[0].position
var p = tree.current_scene.get_node('BoardRoot').get_global_transform_with_canvas() * Vector2(mp.x, mp.y)
TouchInputAdapter.set_meta('w', p)
TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, TouchInputAdapter.get_meta('w'), true)
return true

TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, TouchInputAdapter.get_meta('w') + Vector2(0, 24), false)
return true

var u = GameState.get_unit('U_BATTLEWAGON_T').models[0]
var p = tree.current_scene.get_node('BoardRoot').get_global_transform_with_canvas() * Vector2(u.position.x, u.position.y)
TouchInputAdapter.set_meta('w', p)
TouchInputAdapter.set_meta('w_world', Vector2(u.position.x, u.position.y))
TouchInputAdapter.set_meta('rot0', float(u.get('rotation', 0.0)))
var tok = null
for t in SceneRefs.token_layer().get_children():
	if str(t.get_meta('unit_id', '')) == 'U_BATTLEWAGON_T':
		tok = t
TouchInputAdapter.set_meta('tok_pos', tok.position)
# touch the hull off-centre on purpose (towards the rear)
p = tree.current_scene.get_node('BoardRoot').get_global_transform_with_canvas() * (tok.position + Vector2(0, 30))
TouchInputAdapter.set_meta('w', p)
TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, p, true)
return true

var mc = tree.current_scene.movement_controller
return TouchInputAdapter.state == 8 and mc.dragging_model and TouchInputAdapter.stats.rotate_grabs == 1 and TouchInputAdapter.stats.long_presses == 1

var mc = tree.current_scene.movement_controller
return TouchInputAdapter.stats.rotate_steps == 2 and abs(float(mc.selected_model.get('rotation', 0.0)) - TouchInputAdapter.get_meta('rot0') - PI / 6.0) < 0.01

TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, TouchInputAdapter.get_meta('w') + Vector2(60, 0), false)
return true

var u = GameState.get_unit('U_BATTLEWAGON_T').models[0]
var rot_ok = abs(float(u.get('rotation', 0.0)) - TouchInputAdapter.get_meta('rot0') - PI / 6.0) < 0.01
var mc = tree.current_scene.movement_controller
var tok = null
for t in SceneRefs.token_layer().get_children():
	if str(t.get_meta('unit_id', '')) == 'U_BATTLEWAGON_T':
		tok = t
var stayed = tok.position.distance_to(TouchInputAdapter.get_meta('tok_pos')) < 1.0
return rot_ok and stayed and not mc.dragging_model and TouchInputAdapter.state == 0 and TutorialManager.current_step_id() == 'wagon_confirm'

var gid = 'U_GRETCHIN_T'
var m = GameState.get_unit(gid).models[0]
var p = tree.current_scene.get_node('BoardRoot').get_global_transform_with_canvas() * Vector2(m.position.x, m.position.y)
TouchInputAdapter.set_meta('g', p)
TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, p, true)
return true

TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, TouchInputAdapter.get_meta('g'), false)
return true

var w = tree.current_scene.get_node_or_null('UnitContextMenu')
return TouchInputAdapter.stats.rotate_grabs == 1 and w != null and w.visible
